hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.swift ]]; then out="$("./Scripts/on-write-code-check.sh" "$f" 2>&1)"; jq -n --arg msg "$out" '{systemMessage: $msg, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}'; fi; }
hooks.statusMessage: onWriteCode: running SwiftLint + contextual code rules
